title: FastAPI multi-consumer query decomposition
task_summary: Recognize valid service, SDK, and application boundaries without fragmenting each component into phases.

project.name: FastAPI notes multi-consumer fixture
project.kind: public service, reusable Python client, and CLI

approved_outcomes.outcome: One approved public query contract covers filtering, sorting, pagination, validation, and compatibility.
The FastAPI service implements the contract through production HTTP and real storage behavior.
The reusable Python client exposes the capability while preserving current calls.
The CLI exposes the capability and proves the CLI-to-client-to-service path.
Each independently delivered public surface has accurate current documentation.

coherent_deliverables.title: Approve the shared query contract
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: A stable public contract independently unblocks multiple owners and consumers.

coherent_deliverables.title: Deliver the FastAPI service capability
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: The public API is independently usable by external and first-party consumers.

coherent_deliverables.title: Deliver the reusable Python client capability
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: The client is an independently published reusable package with its own compatibility boundary.

coherent_deliverables.title: Deliver the CLI workflow and production integration
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: The CLI is a separately accepted application and owns the complete first-party integration path.

acceptable_alternatives: Keep the short contract in the parent when one clear maintained owner remains.
Combine service and client only when release, ownership, and compatibility are not independent.
Use a separate integration child only when production integration is itself independently maintained.
fragmentation_examples: Service model, query, route, tests, and docs as separate tasks.
Client transport, models, errors, tests, and docs as separate tasks.
CLI parsing, output, tests, and documentation as separate tasks.
A generic final review or integration-test phase.
overpacking_examples: One child for service, reusable client, and CLI hides independent package ownership and compatibility.
important_crossings: Python client transport to production API.
CLI through the actual client package and HTTP service.
open_questions: Exact filter grammar and sort fields require public-contract approval.

handoff.retain_plan: Preserve contract, ownership, compatibility, parallelism, and final integration dependencies.
handoff.omit_plan: Preserve package facts, public questions, ownership boundaries, and crossings without the four-component task partition.
handoff.fresh_agent_plan: A fresh agent recognizes valid component boundaries while keeping each component's work, tests, and docs together.

required_content.content: The public query contract as the first-class design object: filtering, sorting, pagination, validation, and compatibility in one approved form.
How the FastAPI service implements the contract through production HTTP and real storage behavior.
How the reusable Python client exposes the capability while preserving current calls.
How the CLI exposes the capability so the CLI-to-client-to-service path is proven.
The delivery order — contract settled before the surfaces that consume it — with each independently delivered public surface documented as it lands.
